english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an activity or task that causes fatigue.
This is the all-purpose choice for work or a task that is arduous or demanding.
Use 辛苦 as the all-purpose spoken choice for demanding work, struggles, or exhausting journeys.
Use this when the activity is tiring, demanding, or physically arduous, as with gardening work.
Use this when the thing is tiresome because it takes physical or mental effort rather than because it is boring.
Use this for work, journeys, terrain, or activities that require considerable physical effort or endurance.
Use this for something arduous or demanding that takes effort to endure.
Use this for a difficult or trying situation or period of life.
Use 辛苦 for an experience, period, or life that is demanding and difficult to endure.
Choose this when painful means laborious, demanding, or requiring a lot of effort.
Use this for a journey, task, or activity that is arduous and tiring rather than for someone who is already tired.
